summary: IonQ filed an 8-K reporting routine governance and operational matters: it added two independent directors (Eric R. Ball, Timothy E. Baxter) with standard compensation, and announced the upcoming expiration of its public warrants on September 30, 2026, with trading ceasing September 29, 2026. Warrants are exercisable for common stock at $11.50 per share. No special-situation transaction (merger, tender, restructuring) is involved; this is a routine current report. The warrant expiration is a mechanical corporate event, not a special situation. Watch for potential dilution if warrants are exercised before expiry, but no strategic significance.
